title: 縦型回転焼き機の外観
description: 飲食店の調理台に配置する縦型回転焼き機の外観です。空の縦串と固定フォーク/受け皿、上側駆動部外装、三段の非発光ヒーター面、側面つまみ、実際に凹んだ周縁付き油受け、ゴム脚と背面通気/電源口を造形。肉や食品は含まず、一式1点です。台上設置高さはシーン側で調整してください。回転・加熱・排煙や食品機器の安全性能は未実装・未検証です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.438 × 0.922 × 0.525 m、11,276三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A vertical rotisserie exterior for restaurant counters. It has an empty vertical spit with fixed forks/support disc, upper drive housing, three unlit heater faces, side controls, a genuinely recessed rimmed drip tray, rubber feet and rear vent/power details. No meat or food is supplied; all parts count as one model. Adjust counter placement height. Rotation, heating, ventilation and food-appliance safety performance are unimplemented and untested. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.438 × 0.922 × 0.525 m; 11,276 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
